name: Evidence of 96'
source:
Experience a dark visual novel from the perspective of a deranged high-schooler who committed a serious crime and must now seek to destroy all evidences that point to him.

[From [url=https://teammelon.itch.io/evidence-of-96]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从一名精神错乱的高中生的角度体验一部黑暗视觉小说，他犯下了严重的罪行，现在必须设法销毁所有指向他的证据。

[来自[url=https://teammelon.itch.io/evidence-of-96]itch.io[/url]]
